title: GIG-4035: Re-Run High-Risk Review When A Pull Request Is Approved
description: The generated caller re-runs on review only for the base branch. A title or body edit does not write a risk result after a newer commit has landed.

test_plan.description: An approval on a high-risk pull request turns the required check green
steps: Merge the shared-workflows change first so a review does not classify the diff again
Open a pull request into main that high-risk-review classifies as risk:high
Wait until the check fails
Submit one approving review
Confirm high-risk-review runs again without a new push and finishes green
Dismiss that approval and confirm the check runs again and finishes red

test_plan.description: A review of a pull request into another branch does not start the check
steps: Open a pull request whose base branch is not main
Submit a review
Confirm high-risk-review is skipped and no risk label is applied
Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Command/InitGithubActionsCommandTest.php and confirm it passes

test_plan.description: Retargeting a pull request onto main runs the gate again
steps: Open a pull request whose base branch is not main and submit a review
Confirm high-risk-review is skipped
Change the base branch to main
Confirm high-risk-review runs and classifies the diff
Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Command/InitGithubActionsCommandTest.php and confirm it passes

test_plan.description: A title edit keeps the recorded result
steps: Open a pull request into main and wait until high-risk-review classifies it
Edit the title and confirm the risk label stays in place
Change a pull request base onto main and confirm high-risk-review classifies that diff
Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Command/InitGithubActionsCommandTest.php and confirm it passes

test_plan.description: A title edit classifies only when this commit has no recorded result
steps: Open a pull request into main and wait until high-risk-review classifies it
Edit the title and confirm the risk label stays in place
Push a commit while a run is in progress, edit the title, and confirm the new commit is still classified

test_plan.description: Documentation matches the head check before a title edit writes
steps: Read the high-risk-review section of the ngramx README
Confirm it says a title or body edit does not write a label or comment after a newer commit has landed
